description: Your watches (made with watch_create), newest first, up to 25 per secret: for each, what it watches, what it last saw, its last 10 events (newest first), whether a webhook is set and when it expires. Pass id for just one. Free.

secret.description: Your private secret (16+ chars), the same kind memory_set uses. It owns your watches: list and delete them with it.

name: watch_list
title: List your watches and their events
